name: Edit a room and export a floor plan
description: Confirms a room can be edited and the plan export workflow is available.
steps: Select a room in the 2D plan
Change its name or width in the inspector
expected: The room reflects the edited property and an SVG floor-plan file is downloaded.

name: Add and reposition fixtures
description: Verifies users can add objects and edit their placement and size.
steps: Add a window and a chair
Select the new object and change its width
expected: Both objects appear on the plan and the selected object's dimensions update.

name: Manage floors and project files
description: Checks multi-floor planning and portable project file workflows.
steps: Add a first floor and switch to it
expected: The floor selector updates, a project JSON file downloads, and the duplicate receives a distinct name.

name: Adjust exterior and construction estimate
description: Verifies exterior colours and editable budget assumptions affect the design and estimate.
steps: Open Exterior designer and change the wall colour
expected: The exterior colour changes and the estimate recalculates using the new rate.

name: Use the planner on mobile and delete an item
description: Checks mobile-friendly planning controls and removal of a selected item.
steps: Open the 2D plan at mobile width
Select a room and use delete selected
Confirm the room no longer appears
expected: The plan controls remain usable on mobile and the selected room is removed.
